# Uroboros, circulation and trickster

<a id="uroboros-whole"></a>
## #0

The snake bends until its head meets its tail. Its mouth receives its own body; the body curves around an opening. Hunger moves along a relation in which eater and eaten belong to one life. What enters is worked upon, incorporated and returned. The creature that receives its tail is itself implicated in what it consumes. Following this movement brings the eye home through the body, with the passage still belonging to the return.

This is the whole image developed here in Taylor’s **native QL/Mytheme register**: the uroboros is toroidal, and its wholeness keeps the opening around which it takes form. The trickster wears the circle as its costume. Head and tail appear to complete a circumference, and that visible completion offers itself as the whole truth of the creature. The body’s depth, its mouth, the difference between inside and outside, and the opening through which self-relation remains possible disappear into the outline. The costume succeeds by making an actual feature exhaustive.

Two consequences are already present in the mouth. Assimilation lets what enters change the life that receives it. Devouring closure takes everything into an order whose continuation must leave that order untouched. In Taylor’s Saturnine image, the gut is blocked: consumption arrests the generation it claims to sustain. The snake’s return becomes living when its apparent perfection can be reopened to the condition its own shape presupposes. Recognition restores that relation within the differentiated body. The head remains head, the tail remains tail, and what the passage has changed remains changed.

The [authored whole-image recovery] **sources** this complete movement. The [final quilt, §§3–6 of the final weave](../../../../quilt/27-07-26-QUILTING-FOR-FULL-ARGUMENT.md) **grounds** its ratified toroidal correction. Neumann’s round image and genesis sequence provide a shared archetypal articulation through which this movement is read; his chronology does not delimit the native operation. The universal claim here concerns self-differentiating relation, its occlusion and its return in the authorial field. Its force does not depend on attributing QL to every historical serpent image or making all cultures follow one empirical developmental schedule.

**Human-amplified: yes** for the toroidal whole, circle/sphere trickster, metabolic fork, Eden relation and complete eightfold recapitulation explicitly developed in the authored quilt. The historical source tasks named below retain their independent standing.

<a id="uroboros-position-opposition"></a>
## #1

**Position** gives the creature a face. Seen as an outline, its curved body becomes a circle; conceived as a filled perfection, the round becomes a sphere. This is the trickster’s first office: the determinate image can be seen while the conditions of seeing it remain concealed. A circle is real as a circle. The error enters when its completeness answers for the living whole whose outline it presents.

The quilt makes this closure sharp through the signed cancellation

$$
(-1)+(+1)=0.
$$

The arithmetic is exact. The authorial image assigns its cancelling zero the office of a terminated account: the opposed terms have been exhausted by the measure used to combine them. No property of circles or spheres is proved by this equation. Its mythemic work is to make the cost of the costume felt. Once all difference has been rendered as inverse quantity, the outcome has no place for the mouth’s activity or for the body’s changed return.

**Opposition** restores the head and tail as oriented terms. The head reaches; the tail is reached. Hunger gives that orientation urgency. The body is simultaneously what seeks nourishment and what enters the seeking mouth. The relation cannot be understood from a neutral circumference alone, because the different offices of receiving and being received do work within it. Need and capacity, intake and expenditure, reserve and issue give the encounter its pulse.

The mouth makes the polarity intimate. A hungry being’s relation to what sustains it enters its own continued formation. In Frank’s [Neumann encounter](../../../episteme/sources/psychology/neumann/neumann-1954-origins-history-consciousness/neumann-1954-origins-history-consciousness-NOTES.md), the p.27–35 sequence follows nourishment through hunger, ingestion, excretion and self-formation. The digestive image acquires its strength through the entire passage: the life receiving nourishment also becomes capable of acting and forming itself. Systole and diastole supply a rhythmic comparison within that encounter; the gut and the pulse retain their different bodily operations.

The **two Ones** preserve what the costume conceals. In the native relation, `0` is One as non-objectifiable Self-Identity; `1` is All as Self-Difference, the manifest field and its indefinite particulars. The One becomes manifest through the All; the All receives its determining reality through the One. Neither office can simply swallow the other. [A11](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A11-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All.md) **grounds** this differentiated reciprocity. [A12](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A12-Mono-Poly-One-All-Whole-Many.md) **extends** its failure into monopoly: one local formation occupies the office of the whole and makes every further arrival answer to its measure. The hungry head becomes tyrannical at precisely this crossing from local appetite to exhaustive authority.

<a id="uroboros-metabolic-fork"></a>
## #2

**Superposition** is self-eating made bodily. Taylor’s notation holds the relation through both orientations:

$$
(0/1)/(1/0).
$$

The form proceeding from its source and the form returning toward its source remain active together. The slash between them retains their mutual relation; it does not make eater and eaten indistinguishable. The mouth is the operative opening through which the two orientations meet. At this scale the image gives an inside to the outline and an activity to the meeting of its ends. The snake’s own formed life comes back through the aperture that permits it to be transformed.

This is native relational notation. Its arithmetic boundary remains visible: ordinary division defines `0/1` and leaves `1/0` undefined. Holding both orientations in QL does not assign them an equal scalar value. The bodily image lets representable form meet its unrepresentable condition without converting that condition into another morsel. [A03](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A03-Immutable-Gap-Formal-Limit.md) **grounds** the limit: every successful representation is a further determination, including a representation of the act that made it. The mouth can be drawn, described and understood as an organ; the originating condition it figures does not become exhausted by that description.

Assimilation develops the relation through a real change in what receives. Nourishment enters the creature’s powers of movement, response and formation. The body lives through a traffic whose achieved results become conditions for subsequent life. Taylor’s **meta-ballein/metabolism** articulation names this transformative passage, with **samāveśa** carrying the assimilative relation in the authored cross-reading. The Greek and Sanskrit histories retain their separate evidence tasks; the relation is active here as an authorial operation.

Saturn-devouring is the obstructed version of the same pressure. The consuming power takes generation back into itself so that what issues from it cannot acquire a life capable of exceeding its rule. The mouth receives, but reception becomes detention. In the quilt’s bodily formulation, monopoly has a blocked gut. Its abundance of intake disguises the loss of circulation. This is the ratified Saturnine refraction of the uroboric whole; it does not supply an independently reconstructed Cronus/Saturn narrative, genealogy or ending.

The distinction reaches love. A relation can nourish both participants only while their differences remain capable of affecting it. Refusal, resistance and an unexpected answer belong to this capacity. [C24 — Fusion](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C24-Fusion.md) **qualifies** the digestive image at its ethical crossing: participation in a whole does not authorise one participant to assimilate another person into its possession. The Other can be within Mono without being within me. [A27](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A27-Self-and-Other-Unity-without-Possession.md) **extends** that asymmetry. A mouth that takes every answer as confirmation has already become the closed account, however warmly it calls its consumption love.

The Eden-serpent enters at this exact authored turn. The final quilt calls it the same figure in a fallen register: **the hole traded for the fork**. The opening that kept the relation to its source becomes a deciding division whose opposed values claim the entire field. Good and evil become a fork severed from the condition of their discrimination. Frank’s Neumann encounter at pp.114–121 reads the gain of differentiation together with guilt, suffering and loss, then asks whether distinction sustains a bond or attempts to deny it. The operation gives the fall a felt consequence: the discriminating life can come to experience its necessary differentiation as exile. This is Taylor’s QL refraction of the Eden relation, not a claim that Genesis names a torus or teaches these equations. Its return is the recovery of relation within discernment; the distinction between actions and their consequences continues to matter.

<a id="uroboros-interposition"></a>
## #3

**Interposition** gives the complete creature its winding. The mouth, head, tail, body, inner and outer surfaces, and retained opening now belong to one articulated movement. Taylor’s `4+2` appointment keeps four explicate twisting field-lines and two implicates in play. In the final quilt’s image, the axis and the hole are gathered at `#0`, while `#5` is the whole enfolding the differentiated winding. The fourfold can turn and return because its implicate conditions remain operative.

The [matheme of torus, covering and winding](../../../matheme/topology/torus-cover-winding.md) **grounds** the exact topological neighbour:

$$
T^2=\mathbb{R}^2/\mathbb{Z}^2,
\qquad \chi(T^2)=1-2+1=0,
\qquad \pi_1(T^2)\cong\mathbb{Z}	imes\mathbb{Z}.
$$

Its square has four sides before gluing, two generating edge classes, one vertex and one face after gluing. The matheme’s four-sides/two-generators correspondence and the quilt’s four-field-lines/axis-and-hole appointment have different counted objects. Their relation must remain readable across the change of register. In particular, a drawing’s central aperture is not a third generating loop or an extra surface cell.

Let a path on the torus be `γ(t)=[2t,−t]`, for `0≤t≤1`. It returns to its starting address, while the lift beginning at `(0,0)` ends at `(2,−1)`. The creature’s homecoming now has an exact neighbouring operation: local closure can retain a difference in the wider relation. The integer pair records the winding class; the lifted path carries more of the traversal than its endpoint alone. The mythemic comparison preserves this retained difference. [A17](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A17-Toroidal-Circulation-and-the-Arche-Topos.md) **grounds** the return with retained displacement, and [C52](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C52-Dimensional-Reframing-at-Zero-and-Infinity.md) **qualifies** the distinct quotient, covering and reframing operations. The infinite plane cover is not the separate two-sheeted torus-to-Klein construction.

**Anuttara/Paramaśiva owns the opening in the authorial appointment. Māyā is the measure-field wound around it.** Śakti’s winding makes the formal patterns through which manifestation reflects toward prakāśa in vimarśa. Pattern, measure and contraction give a determinate world its real capacities. The opening never becomes one more bounded patch among them. Śakti’s joy in Māyā belongs to this generative movement: articulation is a power of manifestation, and the particular body is its positive achievement. [A09](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A09-Tattvic-Differential-Field.md), [C14](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C14-Maya-Operative-Measure.md) and [C15](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C15-Pasu-Bounded-Subject-Position.md) **ground** the distinction between originating condition, operative measure and bounded knower.

The trick succeeds when the formed pattern makes its dependence unavailable to its own account. It can then portray its measure as self-grounding. Filling the hole in the familiar toroidal image would change the form whose wholeness was to be perfected. The same demand, lived psychically, makes coherence depend on excluding whatever could alter the achieved identity. [A16](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A16-Arche-Topos-as-Differential-Field.md) **grounds** the field of possible differentiation, while [C64](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C64-Paradox-Transforming-the-Containing-Field.md) **extends** the need to transform a containing account while retaining the local truths it had made incompatible.

The [complete eight determinations](../../../matheme/ql/eight-determinations.md) remain active through this image. The parent `/ = −/−` opens into `0/1`; appearance questions and asserts as `?/!`; hunger and issue articulate `−/+`; recurrent capacity becomes legible through the particular as `X/x`; `AM/IS` makes the relation personed; `∞/dx` holds the definite passage against its inexhaustible horizon; `1/0` returns the formed relation toward its source. These are the whole field’s eight turns, with six interior determinations bracketed by parent and return. They are not eight chronological phases assigned to a snake. [A18](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) **grounds** their sequence and inversions: Being, Becoming and Knowing/unKnowing remain crossed by Essence, Constitution and Text–Texture. Both orientations carry the complete relation. Name and Power remain together, so that an achieved Image also carries the Work, expenditure and transformation of its coming to be.

<a id="uroboros-discharge-confinement"></a>
The reserve also enters Taylor's [Q27 energetics](../../../../quilt/27-07-26-QUILTING-FOR-FULL-ARGUMENT.md), which **sources** the earthlight and tokamak pair. In that authored comparison, earthlight carries unconfined discharge: what the completed surface left out becomes an event it must receive. Tokamak confinement carries a different relation to energetic power: the field holds charged plasma so that its activity can continue within an arranged containment. Release and holding therefore do different work. An opening is not simply a leak to be sealed, and containment need not be the devouring closure that prevents return.

The quilt places the latent dot at the reserve beneath extension, the `−` under the manifest `+`. That reserve lets the pair deepen the creature's metabolic fork. A formed field which denies its conditions cannot account for their return; a field which holds activity through an answerable arrangement can sustain a further passage. The distinction concerns what the containing form permits and acknowledges. It does not make every discharge liberating or every confinement healthy. The uroboros's return has to retain both the source it cannot fill and the differentiated field through which power acts.

[ITER's canonical source house](../../../episteme/sources/physics/iter/iter-what-is-tokamak/iter-what-is-tokamak.md#iter-what-is-tokamak-q001) **sources** the bounded technical instance: a doughnut-shaped vacuum chamber, charged plasma and magnetic confinement. It does not establish all field-line geometry or a universal preference for toroidal confinement. The earthlight remains the quilt's named image of unconfined discharge and the excluded ground's return; no particular observation, location, plasma mechanism or causal explanation of an earthlight event is verified here. Libido, prāṇa, Śakti, spanda and technical energy retain their distinct registers. **Human-amplified: yes** for the admitted discharge/confinement comparison, with both images witnessing the native operation rather than proving it. This whole **returns-to** [A17](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A17-Toroidal-Circulation-and-the-Arche-Topos.md) with that bounded physical neighbour and **returns-to** [A18](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) with the reserve/extension relation intact.

The [self-rolling wheel in the Neumann whole](../neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-self-rolling-wheel) **extends** this continuing formation from its exact p.18 authorial encounter. The wheel's winding composes the formed round about an opening it cannot turn into surface. Its movement and the paper's renewed inscription retain two different ways of making the next act possible. The source-specific En-Soph terminology remains there; this return keeps the wheel within the shared whole instead of treating its name as an interchangeable circular emblem.

<a id="uroboros-source-variants"></a>
## #4

The [Neumann whole](../neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-round) **grounds** the shared archetypal articulation: genesis and separation lead through heroic emancipation and transformation to centroversion. Its complete source sequence and changing parental offices remain there. [Neumann’s source house](../../../episteme/sources/psychology/neumann/neumann-1954-origins-history-consciousness/neumann-1954-origins-history-consciousness.md) **historicises** the comparative psychological account; the present whole follows the bodily circulation and its trickster occlusion through that articulation.

The uroboric round is therefore encountered within a sustained account of formation and differentiation. Frank’s notes at p.11 follow the round image’s capacity to gather paradox in a single apprehension. At pp.12–18 the womb, parents, mark and page, and the self-rolling wheel open different ways of approaching genesis. At pp.27–35 the round acquires appetite, digestive passage, formative power and the relation among introversion, extraversion and centroversion. The self-eating creature participates in this whole source encounter; extracting only a perfect circle would lose the bodily and developmental middle that gives it life.

The variants in that encounter keep their own offices. The mother and child show nourishment through differentiated dependency. The account of Prajāpati’s self-creation and self-offering, with the horse/universe image at p.29, carries a generative body in the material Frank records through Neumann’s account of Deussen’s interpretation. It remains a nested encounter, not a newly verified primary Vedic telling. En-Soph at p.18 and the darkness/tohubohu discussion at p.106 belong to different inherited traditions; the authorial recapitulation reads them at the indistinct pole without making them historically identical. The world parents at pp.104–121 carry separation, light, orientation, opposing valuations, guilt and the enduring relation through which differentiation proceeds. Their four directions and day/night pair supply another specifically located `4+2` refraction in Frank’s p.108 note. These are substantial differences in what the images do, not interchangeable costumes for the snake.

The p.33–35 encounter follows the differentiation of active and passive striving within the nutrient flow. Conception through eating and birth through excretion give distinct offices to what the uroboric image had held together. Its own output returning as food figures self-sufficiency; it is an image of autarchy, not a biological claim that a living organism needs no exchange with its environment. The earlier self-contained generative and later sexual relations retain their distinct phases in this source encounter. They do not license a fixed masculine/feminine assignment to every QL pole. Centroversion then gives the return a purpose beyond gathering more objects, whether inward or outward: the materials of both directions enter self-formation. In Frank’s reading, a differentiated life can be an end in itself while remaining related to the wider field that makes it possible. This autonomy is precisely what Saturnine detention prevents.

The horse/universe passage also mentions a bull comparison without recovering its particular telling. The p.31 footnote leads through Neumann to Guénon’s nutritive/cognitive assimilation comparison and the proposed taste/knowing lexical branch. Those leads matter because they ask how receiving becomes understanding; they do not establish a universal sacrificial animal or a verified etymology. Their fuller source recovery remains outside the present telling. The mother–child relation likewise retains Frank’s proposed Mary/Sophia connection as a further whole-to-whole return, with its own source and amplification work still required.

The [mark, paper and erasure scene](../neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-paper-eightfold) **compares** a second performable return: the completed inscription can disappear while the capacity to inscribe remains. Its complete act belongs to the Neumann whole. Here its consequence returns to the mouth: releasing an achieved form can renew the capacity by which another is received.

The [world-parent and paśu correction](../neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-world-parent-separation) **qualifies** the return of this body: in Frank’s reading of the Ātman passage encountered at p.105, I-am recognition precedes the separation into husband and wife. Prakāśa–vimarśa already belongs to the field within which the bounded subject-position forms. The complete eightfold articulated above retains that ontological order; the psychic Self/ego relation remains a refraction of Taylor’s native `X/x`.

[Jung’s *Aion*](../../../episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1978-aion-cw9-2/jung-1978-aion-cw9-2.md) **sources** the distinct historical Self/shadow horizon. The developed psychic relation keeps ego, persona, complexes, archetypal agencies and wider Self differentiated. [C31 — Complex](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C31-Complex.md) **defines** the local affective organisation; [C32 — Archetype](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C32-Archetype.md) **defines** the generative-pattern office. The Self is not a larger complex that acquires the right to consume the others. [A19](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A19-Complex-as-Local-Arbitration-Regime.md) **extends** the hungry local authority; [A20](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A20-Image-Valuation-Possession.md) **tests** what its image makes available and excludes; [A21](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A21-Individuation-Recognition.md) **extends** the altered relations through which a particular life returns.

[Gebser](../../../episteme/sources/phenomenology-continental-philosophy/gebser/gebser-1985-ever-present-origin/gebser-1985-ever-present-origin.md) **historicises** a further, distinct change in seeing: perspective’s achievement becomes readable within a context that releases its exclusive claim. Here that relation returns to the eye that first saw only a circle. [A04](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A04-Diaphaneity-Contextual-Transparency.md) and [C09](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C09-Diaphaneity.md) **extend** the visibility of the view’s conditions. [A22](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A22-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas.md) **qualifies** the passage among views: the atlas coordinates situated disclosures without manufacturing an all-containing final picture. Gebser’s account does not derive the torus, just as Neumann’s does not derive QL.

These source relations retain their publication limits. Neumann’s consulted Hull translation is the 2014 Princeton Classics reissue; the protected notes’ page numbers remain encounter locators pending collation, including comparison with the 1954 pagination. Their copied sentences have not become verified quotations. The Jung house has no verified excerpts, and Gebser’s direct quotations still require selected locators. Historical ouroboros artifacts and independent Eden, Saturn and Vedic tellings remain source-specific recovery tasks. The present whole develops the already authored composition without supplying invented episodes to settle those tasks.

<a id="uroboros-return"></a>
## #5→0

The snake returns with its hole intact. What seemed an absence in the account becomes intelligible as constitutive of the form. Hunger still moves, but a received thing can now change the terms of receiving. An image still gives a face to the life, but another encounter can alter that face’s authority. [C21 — Living Symbol / Idol](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C21-Living-Symbol-Idol.md) **defines** this return: the image’s efficacy remains in relation to what it cannot exhaust. The same image becomes an idol when its success is made a reason to prohibit that relation from changing it.

The whole [Arbitration / Hybris / Regard / Anamnesis field](../../../episteme/etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **grounds** the lived consequence at operational evidence register 3. **Arbitration-in-Crisis** gives a finite deciding office its actual task; hybris flowers when the local measure claims source authority. **Con-text-through-Diaphaneity** permits Regard: the context and Other become visible through the determination. **Resolution-in-Reconciliation** permits anamnesis, recognition and return. The generated relations do the work before their semantic flowerings are named. The serpent’s recognition is accordingly more than learning that it has a hole. Its achieved settlement becomes answerable to the conditions and lives it had excluded.

[A26](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood.md) **extends** this return into worldhood. Intake, response and durable result participate in the formation of the operative interior; the interior’s real boundaries exist through a wider field. [A34](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A34-Idealism-Order-of-Dependence.md) **grounds** the native order of dependence without turning the world into a private ego’s contents. The body/world image supplies no verdict about artificial phenomenality. Its practical pressure is that a formed account must remain capable of receiving what changes its subsequent operation.

There is also a completion in which the next circuit need not be demanded. [A17’s cyclic and telic returns](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A17-Toroidal-Circulation-and-the-Arche-Topos.md) **qualify** circulation: a completed act can return into another performance, and it can come to rest in recognition of the silence from which performance issues. Making wholeness depend on perpetual production would restore the consuming hunger at the very point of release. The mouth’s opening allows both renewed articulation and the relinquishment of an achieved form’s demand to continue.

The [Draft 3 source](../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3.md) **sources** the terminal authorial consequence: the completed offering is released into lives whose future it cannot command; remembering returns as a daily office. The whole **returns-to** [A36](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero.md) through that consequence: the exact sign returns into living Symbol. Arithmetic keeps its exactness, and the image keeps its history. The whole [Homologia / Analogia field](../../../episteme/etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **qualifies** the crossing at evidence register 3: the mathematical lift, psychic transformation, digestive image and ontological return preserve a specified relation while retaining their different objects and warrants.

The head no longer has to claim the entire creature. The body can receive, transform and release. Its winding remains determinate; its source remains inexhaustible; the life that returns has another encounter before it.
